body.name: E_example
body.type: fully specified two-stratum proximal network instance
body.def: \(\mathfrak E\) has \(L=2\), \(\eta_0=1/16\), \(\eta=1/1000\), \(V=\{0,1,2,3\}\), \(\mathcal X=\{x_1,x_2\}\), \(\mathcal U=\mathcal W=\{1,2\}\), \(P(X=x_j\mid S=s)=1/2\), \(C_{x_1}=\begin{psmallmatrix}3/4&1/4\\1/4&3/4\end{psmallmatrix}\), \(C_{x_2}=\begin{psmallmatrix}1/2&1/2\\1/2&1/2\end{psmallmatrix}\), and ordered edges \(01,12,23,02,03,13\); at \(x_1\), edge \(j\) has latent mixture \((j/8,1-j/8)\), while at \(x_2\) every mixture is \((1/2,1/2)\). The target mixtures are \((7/8,1/8)\) at \(x_1\) and \((1/2,1/2)\) at \(x_2\). Every \(Z_e\) has singleton support. Every conditional potential-outcome kernel puts mass \(1/5\) on \(0000,1000,0100,0010,0001\) and zero elsewhere, the shared bridge is \(g_a(w,x)=0\), and treatment is balanced within every trial.
